concerns.text: Verification for T001 only checks that `grep` finds the new strings and that a unit test passes, but it does not verify that the required *rationale paragraph* referencing the plan’s “kick‑back notes” was actually added. Add an automated test (e.g., assert that the paragraph exists in `spec.md` after the update) or extend the verification description to include this check.

The verification for T010 is described as “Manual inspection; CI test `test_readme_links` checks that the file paths mentioned actually exist.” Relying on manual inspection makes the task non‑deterministic. Replace manual inspection with an automated test that validates the presence and correctness of the quick‑start guide content (e.g., check that the required sections and commands are present) so the task is fully executable.
